xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnComposition:
Gujarat State Financial Corporation is a body corporate established as statutory Corporation by Government of Gujarat pursuant to Section 3 (1) of State Financial Corporations Act, 1951, a Parliament statute. Composition of Board of Directors is governed by Sections 10, 15 and 17 read with Section 4 (3) of the said Act according to which Directors are nominated or elected by respective shareholders. In absence of enabling provision for induction of independent directors on the Board of Directors in the SFCs Act, 1951, Board and its committees do not consist of independent directors. Corporation took up the matter with Securities and Exchange Board of India for continuance of relaxations and exemptions as available before 1st September, 2021. SEBI, vide letter dated December 20, 2021, advised the Corporation to move Government for amendements to SFCs Act, 1951 so as to align it with that of LODR. Accordingly, Corporation moved Government to amend SFCs Act, 1951 vide letter dated December 27, 2021 and is being following up the matter but outcome is still awaited. Thus, Corporate Governance Report is submitted in such a manner that it does not violate the provisions of SFCs Act, 1951 and the Regulations made thereunder.
Pursuant to Order dated April 29, 2017 of Government in General Administration Department, Industries Commissioner is acting as ex-officio Managing Director of the Corporation. Government in GAD vide Notification dated February 01, 2025, transferred Shri Sandip J Sagale, IAS, Industries Commissioner and in his place Shri Swaroop P, IAS has been posted. Shri Swaroop P, IAS took over as Industries Commissioner on February 04, 2025 (BN). Accordingly, he also acts as ex-officio Managing Director of the Corporation with effect from February 04, 2025 and Shri Sandip J Sagale, IAS ceased to be ex-officio Managing Director with effect from 3.2.2025 (AN).

Managing Director being ex-officio, not drawing remuneration from the Corporation. Conditions of appointment and service and remuneration payable to officers and other employees are governed by Regulations as prescribed under Section 23 of the SFCs Act, 1951. In view of the said facts and circumstances, Corporation has not constituted Nomineration and Remuneration Committee.
